gaps.text: Pha KMS publishes no upgrade events; users cannot verify deployment history.
Compose references image by git tag, not digest.
Non-reproducible builds: unpinned base images, npm ci.
No documented link from git commit to image digest to compose hash.
No public document explaining how to verify the deployment.
/evidences/ serves current state only; old quote and cert overwritten on redeploy.
Hardcoded JWT secret fallback in http.ts.
